features.description: Test-first actual-runner/fake-pi integration and the two command-scoped canonical messaging bindings at the existing pi child invocation, preserving AILANG_STORAGE and every runner argument, pipeline, watchdog, and verdict.
acceptance_criteria: AC7: the real checked-out runner is invoked with a fake pi first in PATH in both unset and hostile-caller arms; both return rc 0 and prove the fake child ran
AC7: the fake child receives AILANG_MESSAGES_STORE=gcp and AILANG_MESSAGES_PROJECT=ailang-multivac in both arms
AC7: AILANG_STORAGE remains absent when absent and remains local when supplied by the caller
The test uses MISSION_PI_POLL_SECONDS=1, max/stall 5 seconds, a 15-second Node subprocess backstop, output paths outside the temporary git worktree, and cleans its owned fixture after child exit
AC6: scripts/mission_pi_run.sh changes only by the two command-scoped child messaging bindings; arguments, stdin, awk pipeline, watchdogs, typed verdicts, and retries are unchanged
node --experimental-strip-types --test .pi/extensions/.session-protocol-gate.test.ts, make test-pi-extensions, and git diff --check pass

features.description: Add exactly one source-bound canonical Gate 3 evaluator preamble and focused tests for delivery, command/timeout compatibility, local-history evidence, authority/failure semantics, scope, and the complete independent mutation matrix.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the module-relative actual route resource contains exactly one non-empty delimited preamble whose first line is MISSION-ROLE: evaluator and whose read/list/summarize-classify/ack/judge steps are ordered

AC2: extracted JSON equals the exact bare command ailang messages list --unread --json --limit 1 with numeric timeout 30; the real bashAllowed and armed shouldBlock admit it while env/assignment prefixes do not

AC3: extracted read/list calls make headlessPrerequisitesMet(branch: unknown[]).met true; controller prose and omission controls are false; an isError:true result documents that the current predicate checks calls rather than success
AC3: source text requires a successful listing before session_protocol_ack {}, requires acked=true before judge work, and never claims mechanical result-success enforcement

AC4: recipe requires launcher canonical store/project without touching AILANG_STORAGE, distinguishes protocol ack from inbox-message ack, and requires exact error reporting, stop, and existing fallback on timeout/failure

AC5: the independent evaluator kills every named recipe, order, command, timeout, success/failure, ack, authority, runner-binding, and storage mutation one at a time and records diff, command, nonzero rc, red test, restoration, and green control
AC5: removing only the new recipe block fails a new acceptance test while the seven original guard tests remain green
AC6: focused and aggregate pi-extension tests, make check-context-docs, make check-skills, whitespace checks, controller make test, and controller make lint pass

AC6: only the three frozen implementation files differ from design commit 13ac9c21a6135e3c4640ece3f84b9b86683702f5; session-protocol-gate.ts, scripts/test_mission_pi_run.sh, and the parked iteration-339 candidate remain unchanged
AC7: both actual-runner fake-pi environment arms remain green after the route-resource change
The evaluator runs in a separate sibling worktree at the reviewed sprint commit; generator is not judge, and absent report or failed handshake is routing failure rather than a verdict
